## Research Objective
Clear statement of what we need to learn and why this research is critical for the rebranding success.

## Strategic Context
- **Decision Impact**: What decisions this research will inform
- **Risk Mitigation**: What risks this research helps avoid
- **Success Dependency**: How this affects overall rebranding success

## Research Questions

### Primary Questions
1. Core question that must be answered for project success
2. Key validation needed for strategic direction

### Secondary Questions  
1. Additional insight that would improve decision-making
2. Nice-to-know information that adds context

### Validation Questions
1. Assumption that needs testing/confirmation
2. Hypothesis that requires data validation

## Methodology
- **Research Approach**: Survey/Interview/Analysis/Focus Groups/etc.
- **Sample Size**: Target number of participants and rationale
- **Sampling Method**: How participants will be selected
- **Duration**: Expected time to complete each phase
- **Success Metrics**: How we'll measure research quality

## Target Participants
- **Primary Audience**: Main research subjects (e.g., current go-starter users)
- **Secondary Audience**: Additional perspectives needed (e.g., enterprise decision makers)
- **Sample Criteria**: Specific requirements for participants
- **Recruitment Strategy**: How we'll find and engage participants

## Research Design
- **Data Collection**: Specific methods and tools
- **Question Design**: Key topics and question types
- **Bias Mitigation**: How we'll ensure objective results
- **Validation Methods**: How we'll confirm findings

## Deliverables
- [ ] Research plan and methodology document
- [ ] Data collection instruments (surveys, interview guides)
- [ ] Raw data (anonymized and secure)
- [ ] Data analysis and statistical summary
- [ ] Research findings report with insights
- [ ] Strategic recommendations for next steps
- [ ] Presentation for stakeholders

## Timeline
- **Research Design**: Week X (design questions, methodology)
- **Participant Recruitment**: Week X (identify and engage participants)
- **Data Collection**: Weeks X-Y (execute research activities)
- **Analysis**: Week Z (analyze data and identify patterns)
- **Reporting**: Week Z (create findings report and recommendations)

## Budget
- **Research Tools/Software**: $XXX (survey platforms, analysis tools)
- **Participant Incentives**: $XXX (compensation for time)
- **External Vendor**: $XXX (specialized research firm if needed)
- **Internal Time**: XXX hours (team member effort)
- **Total Estimated Cost**: $XXX

## Quality Standards
- **Sample Size**: Minimum participants needed for statistical significance
- **Response Rate**: Target response rate and follow-up plan
- **Data Quality**: Standards for complete/valid responses
- **Analysis Rigor**: Statistical methods and confidence levels

## Success Metrics
- [ ] Research questions answered with high confidence
- [ ] Statistically significant sample size achieved
- [ ] Response quality meets standards (complete, thoughtful responses)
- [ ] Actionable recommendations provided
- [ ] Stakeholder review completed with approval
- [ ] Follow-up research needs identified

## Risk Management
**High Risk:**
- Low response rate → Multiple recruitment channels, incentives
- Biased sample → Diverse recruitment strategy, validation methods
- Poor question design → Expert review, pilot testing

**Medium Risk:**
- Timeline delays → Buffer time built in, parallel activities
- Budget overruns → Approval process, cost monitoring

## Data Privacy & Ethics
- [ ] Participant consent process designed
- [ ] Data anonymization plan created
- [ ] Secure data storage configured
- [ ] Data retention policy defined
- [ ] Ethics review completed (if required)

## Validation Plan
- **Internal Review**: Who will review methodology and findings
- **External Validation**: How findings will be validated with participants
- **Cross-Reference**: Other data sources to confirm findings
- **Bias Check**: How we'll identify and address research bias

## Related Research
- **Previous Studies**: Existing research that informs this work
- **Complementary Research**: Other research happening in parallel
- **Follow-up Research**: What additional research this may trigger

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All research questions answered with sufficient confidence
- [ ] Sample size and quality meet defined standards
- [ ] Statistical analysis completed with appropriate methods
- [ ] Findings report includes clear insights and recommendations
- [ ] Stakeholder presentation delivered and approved
- [ ] Data archived securely with proper documentation
- [ ] Research informs next phase planning

## Communication Plan
- **Progress Updates**: Weekly status to epic owner
- **Milestone Reviews**: Key decision points and approvals needed
- **Results Sharing**: How and when findings will be communicated
- **Stakeholder Engagement**: Who needs to be involved and when
